title: onelobby.json (OneLobby blueprint)
description: One settings file for a game's multiplayer: the agent skill and create-onelobby write it, OneLobby.fromConfig (JS) and Blueprint.Load (C#) read it. Design: docs/design/blueprint.md. Every key but game.id has a default. "$comment" keys are allowed anywhere and ignored. Cross-key rules are listed in x-rules; the loaders enforce them with the same rule ids (spec/vectors/blueprint.json).

id.description: Reverse-DNS id. Lobbies only match players of the same game.

netVersion.description: Bump whenever command bytes or rules change; mismatched versions cannot join each other.

title.description: Shown in the generated UI; defaults to the folder name.

engine.description: Picks the recipe, package and transport. Shapes the defaults of hosting.direct, hosting.server, lobby.joinLink and ui.kind.

direct.description: Players host from their own machine with a join code: keeps working after any server is gone. Default: true unless engine is web (a browser cannot listen on a port).

server.description: Lobbies through a lobby server (codes, public list, TURN relay). Default: true for engine web, false otherwise.

lobbyServer.description: Default lobby server URL (ws:// or wss://). A setting, never a constant: players can override it.

directPort.description: Port a direct host listens on (falls back up to +9 when taken).

openPort.description: Ask the router to open the direct port (UPnP / NAT-PMP / PCP).

nostr.description: Direct host: also hand out a Nostr code (version 1) that works through public Nostr relays, no port forwarding needed. Off: IP codes only.

nostrRelays.description: Nostr relay URLs (wss://) for the Nostr code. Default: the library's list, probed with checkNostrRelays when the blueprint was written.

relayOnly.description: Server lobbies only: force TURN so players never see each other's IP.

allowedOrigins.description: Extra page origins a direct host accepts browser joiners from.

listed.description: Show hosted lobbies in a public Browse list. Off: join by code or link only.

approveJoins.description: The host approves each joiner. Cannot be combined with listed.

password.description: The game asks the host for a lobby password.

lateJoin.description: Players may join a game already in progress.

rejoin.description: A player who drops or reloads takes their old seat back.

joinLink.description: Offer a shareable join link. Default: true for engine web and node-browser.

meta.description: Lobby key/value strings: at most 16 keys, keys and values at most 64 characters.

mode.description: lockstep: deterministic sim, host orders commands. raw: you send bytes. replication: host-authoritative snapshots (C# only).

hashEveryTicks.description: Lockstep: compare state hashes this often. Default: tickRate (once a second).

identity.description: name: players type a name. anonymous: no names, everyone is Player N. platform: the platform name (Steam), else name.

text.description: Text chat. Players can talk to strangers: a rating disclosure.

voice.description: Voice chat (asks for the microphone). Off unless the game has a reason for it.

hostLeaves.description: end: the session ends for everyone. migrate: another player becomes host (server lobbies only).

pause.description: off: no network pause (lobby.Pause.Request / pause.request throws pause_disabled). host: only the host pauses and resumes. anyone: any player pauses; the pauser or the host resumes. A lobby made without a blueprint behaves as anyone.

readyTimeoutMs.description: A joiner that cannot reach the host gives up after this long. 0 waits forever.

peerTimeoutMs.description: Drop a silent peer after this long. 0 uses the built-in ~30 s; otherwise at least 6000.

rateLimit.description: Cap each joiner's incoming raw messages; the excess is dropped.

runInBackground.description: Keep networking while the window is unfocused.

platforms.description: Platform adapters (blueprint s.9). Accepted today, not built yet.

kind.description: drop-in: the <one-lobby> element (web). generated: menus written into the game. none: you build it. Default: drop-in for engine web, generated otherwise.

entry.description: Where multiplayer lives in the game's menus, e.g. "Main menu: Play together".

allOf.$comment: rule hosting_none (path hosting): at least one of direct, server
rule listed_and_approve (path lobby): listed and approveJoins cannot both be true
rule direct_needs_listener (path hosting.direct): engine web cannot host direct
rule replication_needs_csharp (path sync.mode): replication needs a C# engine (godot-csharp, unity, dotnet) and an explicit engine
rule migrate_with_replication (path session.hostLeaves): replication has no host migration

x-rules.$comment: Rules that depend on engine-dependent defaults cannot be written in plain JSON Schema; the loaders apply them after filling defaults.

hosting_none.message: at least one of direct, server must be true

listed_and_approve.message: listed and approveJoins cannot both be true

direct_needs_listener.message: engine web cannot host direct (a browser cannot listen on a port)

replication_needs_csharp.message: replication needs engine godot-csharp, unity or dotnet

migrate_with_replication.message: replication has no host migration; use end

migrate_needs_server.message: migrate needs hosting.server (direct lobbies always end)
